title: Kenworth T610 Custom Built FUPS Compliant Road Train Bullbar #70
description: Kenworth T610 hi-tensile FUPS deep channel style Road Train Bullbar with additional cross pipe in front of grill. Standard 76mm diameter pipe but optional 88mm pipe can be ordered. High tensile aluminium 6mm wall thickness box uprights for maximum strength plus channel top extender plates on outer corners. Optional aluminium reversible Road Train/ Long Vehicle signs on alloy plates plus Dangerous Goods signs mounted on 10mm plates. The bull bar can be custom built to your specification. Heavy duty high tensile aluminium backing plate with tow pin resulting in 80kg weight saving. Custom driving light mounts can be fitted as required.
